references.text: Jair, son of Manasseh, took the whole region of Argob as far as the border of Geshur and Maacah, and called it Havvoth-jair after his own name
Describes Jair's villages in Gilead as part of Manasseh's inheritance
Mentions another Jair from Gilead who judged Israel, whose sons had thirty cities called Havvoth-jair
Mentions Havvoth-jair in Gilead as part of Solomon's administrative districts
Describes Jair's cities in Gilead and how they were taken by Geshur and Aram
